[[Lion's Gate]] | henchman = y | armorer = y | storage = y | pic1 = [[Image:Kamadan, Jewel of Istan world map.jpg|196px]] | pic1-text = On the world map | pic2 = [[Image:Consulate Docks inside.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = A view inside }} The '''Consulate Docks''' is a private harbor and staging area for use by the [[Istan]]i government for official purposes. {{Quotation|game| These docks, located behind the imposing [[Consulate]] building at the northern end of [[Kamadan]], are used solely for official government business. They can only be accessed though the Consulate, and then only with written approval. Elders traveling to the [[Elona|Elonian]] mainland, as well as ambassadors from [[Kourna]] and [[Vabbi]], depart from here, bypassing the chaos of the common docks, which are used for trade vessels and tourists. }} ==Getting there== This outpost is first reached as part of the [[primary quest]] [[The Time is Nigh]], after a cutscene in the Consulate. Once that quest has been completed, traveling to this location via the Consulate is no longer possible; you must use [[map travel]]. It is not uncommon to see players offering or looking for a "[[ferry]] to the Docks" in [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan|Kamadan]]. The ferry refers to a [[character]] with the Time is Nigh quest active. Since the quest will bring that character here, any other character in his or her party will also be brought here, regardless of their level or any other requirements. The reason most players do this is solely to get access to the maxed armor that can be [[craft]]ed in this location, or to join a party doing the quests that allow travel to Tyria or Cantha (and get ferried again). ==Exits== *[[Bejunkan Pier]] (via [[Mhenlo]], only for Nightfall characters that have completed [[Plague in Cantha]]) *[[Consulate]] (west) *[[Lion's Gate]] (via Mhenlo, only for Nightfall characters that have completed [[Terror in Tyria]]) ==Quests available== *[[Dinja]] **[[All for One and One for Justice]] **[[Chasing Zenmai]] ==NPCs== ===Allies=== ====Services==== *{{x}} 10 [[Vatundo]] ([[armorer]]) *{{x}} 15 [[Xunlai Agent]] ([[storage upgrades]]) *{{x}} 24 [[Xunlai Chest]] ([[storage]]) =====Henchmen===== :''(all level 17)'' *{{w}} [[Devona]] (Fighter) *{{r}} [[Aidan]] (Archer) *{{mo}} [[Kihm]] (Monk) *{{n}} [[Eve]] (Blood) *{{me}} [[Odurra]] (Domination) *{{e}} [[Cynn]] (Fire) *{{e}} [[Herta]] (Earth) *{{p}} [[Sogolon]] (Motivation) *{{d}} [[Gehraz]] (Holy) ====Other allies==== *{{mo}} 20 [[Mhenlo]] *{{x}} 20 [[Dinja]] *{{x}} 20 [[Kohjo]] *{{x}} 20 [[Lahna]] *{{x}} 20 [[Raidmarshal Mehdara]] ([[mission starter]]) *{{x}} 15 [[Yamamank]] ([[mission briefing]]) ==Notes== *This is one of very few [[outpost]]s that does not have a [[merchant]]. * Complete exploration of this outpost contributes less than 0.1% to the Elonian [[Cartographer]] title. {{Anomaly|The loading screen for this area is the loading screen for Kourna.}} {{Bug|A character may [[ferry]] other characters to this outpost way before they should have access to it, while normally when characters that have not fulfilled the requirements to enter would be left out of the party when other players enter it, as happens in [[Vizunah Square (Local Quarter)]] without first completing [[Zen Daijun]].}} {{Towns and outposts in Istan}}
